t: This is the Church of St John in Barnet, in the NW4 area of north London. It was designed by Temple Lushington Moore, an English architect who worked from London but whose buildings are found across England, especially in the North. Moore is best known for a run of fine Gothic Revival churches built between about 1890 and 1917, and he also restored many older churches and designed church fittings. So this is one of the places where you can see that Gothic Revival tradition in a London suburb.
